purpose: Review city-local registry basis and anonymous geometry-only routes without querying personal/property attributes.
primaryPublisher: Sri Lanka Survey Department; Registrar General’s Department; Kandy Municipal Council
registryBasis: The official Survey Department’s public “Download Parcel Info KML data” page links a `Cadastre(Kandy).kmz` file. The Kandy link is a genuine public parcel-geometry candidate, but the page exposes no field schema or safe attribute allowlist. The Survey Department states that its parcel-based LIS is attributed with tenement information, so downloading the full district file before screening its attributes could expose landholding identifiers. The file was not fetched, and no geometry was retained. Separately, the Registrar General’s Department lists Kandy among active title-registration offices, where cadastral maps are integrated with land title records.

officialSources.observation: The official Survey Department site is titled “Download Parcel Info KML data,” provides a district selector, and publicly links `Cadastre(Kandy).kmz`. It does not declare the file’s fields, owner/tenement attributes, extent, or a geometry-only download option. The file was not fetched.

The Survey Department explains that its cadastral maps support land-title registration and that its parcel-based Land Information System is attributed with tenement information collected for title issuance. This is why the Kandy KMZ was not fetched until its schema can be screened.
The Survey Department describes its national surveying/cadastre role and public land-information products, including GIS/CAD map data and copies of existing survey plans for customers.
The Registrar General’s Department identifies title registration as incorporating a cadastral map and lists Kandy among the implementing land-registration offices.

Kandy Municipal Council’s Land Division describes local map preparation, measurement, municipal land management, and land-plan processes. This is local institutional evidence, not a general private-parcel layer.
